evidence: The connected Alpaca ChatGPT market-data surface exposes stock quotes, trades, latest quote/trade and snapshot tools with explicit feed selectors including SIP.

A direct same-conversation historical SIP probe succeeded for AAPL on 2026-10-02 15:59:59 ET, returning Tape C quote events with bid/ask, exchange identifiers and UTC event timestamps, and separate Tape C trade events with exchange identifiers and independent UTC timestamps.
This proves the connector can retrieve exact CTA/UTP SIP-derived Tape C quote/trade data after the free historical-delay window and proves the required A/B payload shape for historical evidence.

The successful Saturday historical SIP read does NOT prove realtime RTH SIP entitlement because Alpaca Basic officially allows older SIP data while restricting recent SIP data; Alpaca states recent SIP trades/quotes inside the latest 15 minutes require Algo Trader Plus or another qualifying subscription.
The connected plugin's latest SIP quote/trade tools returned connector INTERNAL_ERROR on Saturday. This is not an entitlement PASS or FAIL and cannot substitute for a same-run RTH probe.

Alpaca's official March 2026 ChatGPT integration announcement and OpenAI's Alpaca plugin page both state that the ChatGPT integration exposes live stock/options/crypto market data. Neither reviewed page identifies the equity live feed as SIP rather than IEX.

Alpaca's March 2026 launch article says the integration can be enabled from a ChatGPT Plus plan. OpenAI's current plugin documentation says plugin availability/features depend on plan and a limited set is available on Free. Strict G9-C therefore cannot assume permanent-$0 access to this exact Alpaca plugin surface without current provider/platform proof that the qualifying SIP entitlement has no paid plan/subscription condition.

Historical XRAY scheduled tasks have successfully invoked the connected Alpaca market-data connector, proving scheduler-to-plugin technical callability for Alpaca reads in principle. A live strict-G9 RTH witness still requires the exact plugin surface to return recent SIP quote/trade events <=60s old in the scheduled run.

Alpaca Support ticket #366689 replied on 2026-10-03 that standard U.S.-equity live SIP access requires Algo Trader Plus at $99/month, while Basic is IEX realtime and SIP historical data inside the latest 15 minutes is not available.

The same Alpaca Support response stated that it could not verify the exact live U.S.-equity feed used inside the ChatGPT integration, any special SIP entitlement specific to the integration, connector-specific timestamp behavior, or integration-specific fee/account requirements.

Alpaca Support also stated that the launch information describes enabling Alpaca from a ChatGPT Plus plan; this is additional evidence of a possible paid-platform condition, but XRAY will not assume exclusivity until a human/product-team confirmation.

Because the support response was explicitly marked automatically generated using AI, XRAY requested human Market Data/Partnerships/ChatGPT-integration escalation under ticket #366689 to choose between normal per-user IEX/SIP entitlement and a separate platform-level SIP agreement.
